title: Figma Jutro Handoff
description: Schema for the JSON handoff file exported by Alchemy Journey Studio and consumed by the Alchemy Journey to Figma plugin.

format.description: Fixed identifier that identifies this file as an Alchemy Journey Studio handoff.

version.description: Handoff format version. The Figma plugin must check this before importing.

generatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the handoff was exported.

id.description: URL-safe slug derived from the journey name, e.g. 'motor-claims-fnol-journey'.

name.description: Human-readable journey name, e.g. 'Motor Claims FNOL Journey'.

status.description: Approval status of the journey at the time of export.

figmaPageName.description: Suggested Figma page name for the plugin to create, e.g. 'Motor Claims FNOL Journey / Generated screens'.

name.description: Name of the design system the component mappings are based on.

status.description: Advisory note about component mapping accuracy.

responsiveFrames.description: List of responsive frame sizes the plugin should generate. Version 1 produces Desktop only.

screens.description: Ordered list of journey screens. The plugin creates one Figma frame per screen.

id.description: Unique screen identifier generated by Journey Studio.

order.description: 1-based position of this screen in the journey.

name.description: Screen name shown in the stepper and Figma frame name, e.g. 'Incident details'.

figmaFrameName.description: Suggested Figma frame name, e.g. 'Journey / Incident details'.

description.description: Instructional subtitle shown below the screen heading.

desktop.description: Number of columns in the desktop layout. Version 1 is always 2.

conditionalSections.description: Sections that are shown only when a trigger field equals a specific value.

actions.description: Buttons displayed at the bottom of the screen.

backScreenId.description: ID of the previous screen, or null if this is the first screen.

nextScreenId.description: ID of the next screen, or null if this is the last screen.

id.description: Unique field identifier generated by Journey Studio.

label.description: Human-readable field label shown above the input, e.g. 'Date of incident'.

inputType.description: Input type. Maps to a Jutro form component and a Figma component.

options.description: Dropdown options for 'select' fields. Empty array for all other types.

figmaComponent.description: Figma component key to use, e.g. 'Form / Text Input'. Must be verified against the approved Figma library.

jutroComponent.description: Jutro React component name, e.g. 'TextInput'. Must be verified against the approved Jutro library.

cssClass.description: CSS class applied to the component, e.g. 'jutro-text-input'.

states.description: Which Figma component states the plugin should generate for this field.

id.description: Unique rule identifier generated by Journey Studio.

sectionName.description: Heading shown above the conditional section, e.g. 'Urgent request details'.

visibleWhen.description: The condition that must be true for this section to appear.

fieldLabel.description: Label of the trigger field (for display purposes).

equals.description: The answer value that triggers this section, e.g. 'Yes'.

fields.description: Fields shown inside this conditional section.

id.description: Unique action identifier generated by Journey Studio.

label.description: Button label, e.g. 'Continue' or 'Save and continue later'.

actionType.description: Semantic action type. 'back' navigates to the previous screen, 'save' saves a draft, 'continue' validates and advances.

jutroComponent.description: Jutro React component name. Always 'Button' in Version 1.

variant.description: Button variant. 'continue' maps to 'primary'; 'back' and 'save' map to 'secondary'.
